'''Nova bombs''' were a type of explosive. [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure|Zorba the Hutt]] used these weapons alongside ion explosives and [[Doonium/Legends|doonium]] acid mines to destroy [[Trioculus]]'s factory on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].
